name: Yurius Kingdam
original_name: ユーリウス＝キングダム
source:
Main character. Also known as Yuri. 

He has been prejudiced from an early age, and his character is completely distorted, extremely self-centered, and selfish. He will do whatever it takes to fulfill his desires, but he is not always thorough and often makes mistakes.

He is also a petty person, and when he makes a mistake, he is unusually quick to run away from it.

He became tired of life in the royal family and left the country as soon as he came of age at the age of 15. He was a carefree adventurer, relying on his swordsmanship, when he heard that the king was to be elected, he returned home.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill03/chara.html]official site[/url]]
